name: OpenVibe.Video
description: OpenVibe.Video is the video site of the OpenVibe network: stream recordings and clips from OpenVibe.Live, your own uploads and recordings made in the browser (camera or screen), each with a player, AI captions, chapters and a summary, its OpenVibe.Community thread, and a page per channel. The files stay on OpenVibe.Media. Publishing to other platforms comes later.

pillars.title: Watch
pillars.text: Recordings and clips from OpenVibe.Live, uploads, and a page per channel.

pillars.title: Upload
pillars.text: Upload a video, private, unlisted or public; it plays from OpenVibe.Media.

pillars.title: Record
pillars.text: Record your camera or screen in the browser and keep it as a video, never live.

pillars.title: AI edit
pillars.text: Captions from a transcript, chapters from the highlights and a summary you can use as the description, made on OpenVibe's own servers.

pillars.title: Playlists
pillars.text: Put recordings and clips in order, private, unlisted or public, and share them.

pillars.title: Next
pillars.text: Publishing to other platforms is not built yet.

keywords: openvibe video, video hosting, youtube alternative, multi-platform upload, ai video tools

meanwhile.label: OpenRestream
meanwhile.note: Restreaming to many platforms is the sibling product.

meanwhile.label: OpenVibe.Live
meanwhile.note: Owners manage their recordings and clips on OpenVibe.Live.
